findings.obs_text: Evil is the content or the quality of the thoughts in Gen 6:5, Job 21:27, Psa 56:5, Psa 64:5, Isa 59:7, Jer 4:14, Eze 38:10, Mat 9:4, Mat 15:19, Mar 7:21 and Jam 2:4: the thoughts are evil, schemes to wrong, thoughts of iniquity that lodge within and come out of the heart. In Pro 12:5, Pro 15:26, Pro 21:29 and Isa 55:7 the wicked are set against the righteous and upright and are called to forsake their thoughts, and in Psa 10:4 the wicked man's thoughts deny God. In Job 15:35 evil is born of what is conceived, in 2Sa 14:17 the king discerns good and evil, and in 1Cor 14:20 the believers are to be infants in evil but mature in thinking.
findings.grounds: How long shall your wicked thoughts lodge within you
